physical: The electric flux through any closed surface equals the enclosed charge divided by the permittivity of free space. (Φ_E = Q ÷ ε0)
reflected_sentence: The total Idle outflow through a closed surface equals the enclosed source strength divided by the medium constant.
rule_reason: Identity form with zero resistance or separation costs keeps its shape.
interpretation: Idle reflects electric in this identity, which keeps its shape because neither charge nor flux nor permittivity carries resistance or separation.
closing: The rule unambiguously says an identity with no resistance or distance costs keeps its shape, while flux, charge, and permittivity go into unmapped_terms.
